uk.summary: P2P Merchant Leaderboard на Bybit — щотижневе змагання для P2P-мерчантів: найкращі за кількістю виконаних ордерів або за обсягом торгівлі отримують USDT. В анонсі сказано, що можна заробити до 350 USDT щотижня.

Змагатися в одній або обох категоріях: виконання ордерів (order completion) і обсяг торгівлі (trading volume).
Перед стартом відкрийте повні правила на Bybit: в анонсі не сказано, чи потрібна реєстрація в лідерборді, які дати проведення і скільки місць отримують нагороду.

en.summary: The Bybit P2P Merchant Leaderboard is a weekly contest for P2P merchants: the top performers by order completion or by trading volume win USDT. The announcement says you can earn up to 350 USDT every week.
steps: Be a P2P merchant on Bybit (a merchant is a trader who posts their own ads on P2P). The leaderboard is for merchants, not regular buyers. The announcement does not explain how to become one.
Trade on Bybit P2P as a merchant during the week: the ranking is based on weekly trading performance.
Compete in one or both categories: order completion and trading volume.
Before you start, open the full rules on Bybit: the announcement does not say whether you need to sign up for the leaderboard, what the dates are, or how many places are rewarded.

payout.when: Not stated. The announcement only says 'every week', with no payout date and no deadline to claim.
payout.form: USDT — up to 350 USDT per week. There is no reward table, so the amount per rank is unknown. The announcement also does not say whether this is withdrawable USDT or a bonus/voucher.
payout.how: The announcement does not say where the reward appears or whether you have to claim it. Check the full rules on Bybit.

watch: Only a preview of the announcement was available — the full rules probably contain conditions not covered here.
It's a ranking: only the top merchants get rewards. Trading alone does not guarantee a prize.
350 USDT is the maximum ('up to'), not what everyone gets.
Region limits, KYC (identity check) and merchant requirements are not stated in the preview.
If you trade more just to climb the ranking, the costs and risks are yours, and the reward is not guaranteed.

faq.q: Can a regular user, not a merchant, join?
faq.a: The announcement only talks about merchants ('top-performing merchants'). It says nothing about regular users taking part.
Two: order completion and trading volume. According to the announcement, you can earn rewards in both.

faq.q: When does it start and end?
faq.a: The preview gives no start or end date. It only says the rewards are weekly.

faq.q: How many winners are there each week?
faq.a: Not stated: the preview has no table of ranks and amounts.
The preview does not mention registration. Check the full rules on the Bybit event page.

faq.q: Is 350 USDT for one category or both?
faq.a: The announcement says 'up to 350 USDT every week' without a breakdown by category. How the amount is split is not explained.
